past.title: Koosah: Visionary Vineyards Event
past.body:
Join us for an extraordinary and highly anticipated afternoon celebrating one of the most exciting vineyard sites in North America, Koosah Vineyard.

SECURE YOUR TICKET HERE

Perched in the Eola Amity Hills and thoughtfully developed by Kevin Chambers, Koosah is already establishing itself as a benchmark site in the Willamette Valley. Now under the ownership of Résonance, the Oregon estate of Maison Louis Jadot, the vineyard stands at the intersection of visionary farming and global winemaking pedigree.

This event brings together producers who work with Koosah, each offering a distinct perspective on this remarkable site. Tasted side by side, these wines reveal the full dimension of the vineyard, its energy, structure, and clarity, shaped by both place and the hands of the winemakers behind them.

This is a rare opportunity to explore a single vineyard through multiple lenses, gaining a deeper understanding of how site and intent come together in the glass. Winemakers will share their insights and offer an inside look at Koosah and the philosophies that guide their work. The afternoon will feature a moderated conversation led by Justin Moore MS, who will guide an engaging discussion, exploring the philosophy, farming, and decisions that shape these wines.

Featured Wineries

  • 00 Wines

  • Granville Wines

  • Martin Woods

  • Morgen Long

  • Perlee Vineyards

  • Resonance Wines

  • Walter Scott 

More than a tasting, this is a celebration of site, community, and the pursuit of excellence. Whether you have followed Koosah from the beginning or are discovering it for the first time, this is not an event to miss.

Panel Conversation 12-1, Tasting 1-3

Your ticket will be held under your name at the door.
past.excerpt: Join us for this special event celebrating Koosah Vineyard, from 12-3pm.
